SAFETY IS EVERYONE'S PROBLEM

A workplace safety poster starring a duck in a hard hat. Chevron border, industrial yellow, the confidence of someone who has never read the manual.

THE TEE

• DTF print — soft to the touch, no cracking, no stiff plastic square

SHIPPING
• Made and shipped from Dallas, Texas, within 1 business day
• Tracking on every order
